business_problem: The consortium needed a way to orchestrate cloud-edge resources for holographic and XR services whose latency and bandwidth demands exceed what current networks can reliably handle.
solution_summary: Capgemini contributed key AI and edge-orchestration components to the 6G-XR project so holographic communication and distributed XR workloads could run across a multi-site European testbed. The solution combines a network congestion function with a predictive algorithm that anticipates traffic problems, then automatically reprioritizes data flows to keep immersive sessions usable under uplink pressure. In parallel, Capgemini helped build a demonstrator that selects the best nearby server in real time based on user location and network conditions, showing how cloud-edge migration can keep latency low for demanding XR experiences. The company also deployed its Intelligence Edge Application Platform (IEAP) at the Madrid node, exposed capabilities through open APIs, and helped connect Madrid and Barcelona using the GSMA Open Gateway model, turning AI-driven resource orchestration into an operational 6G building block rather than a lab concept.

solution_components.role: Automatically adjusts traffic priorities when holographic workloads threaten to saturate the network.

solution_components.name: predictive algorithm
solution_components.role: Anticipates congestion issues before they degrade XR communication quality.

solution_components.name: Intelligence Edge Application Platform (IEAP)
solution_components.role: Orchestrates applications on nearby servers and exposes network functions through open APIs.

solution_components.name: web-based controller
solution_components.role: Lets teams run end-to-end experiments across the federated testbed from a single interface.

data_flow: XR and holographic workloads enter the federated testbed, where the congestion function and predictive algorithm assess network conditions and adjust traffic handling. IEAP and the web-based controller then orchestrate application placement across edge nodes, selecting the best nearby server based on location and network status so low-latency experiences can be maintained.
business_outcome: The consortium proved that AI-driven edge orchestration can keep immersive communications usable across congested networks and created a reusable foundation for interoperable 6G services and open developer access.
